tone.target: jangly clean Vox-style rhythm with light chorus
tone.profile: jangly clean Vox-style rhythm with light chorus
tone.summary: The chain uses light compression and an OD boost to add grit before feeding into the AC30 TB model. The UK Vintage 4x12 cab provides the necessary bright, chimey British voicing, topped off with Chorus for the required jangle.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a subtle grit and boost the signal for better definition (chime).
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 as it offers a slightly cleaner, more vintage British edge suitable for Vox tones.

blocks.purpose: Smooth out dynamics and add sustain for a tight rhythm feel.

blocks.gap: The target tone requires clean edge, so no dedicated drive/distortion is used here.

Provide the classic British voicing and bright character associated with Vox tones.
blocks.gap: While a specific 12-inch cab is requested, the UK Vintage 4x12 provides the closest tonal profile (British chime) available in the catalog.

blocks.purpose: Add the required subtle jangling chorus effect.

Add subtle space and depth without sounding muddy.
